summary: Accepted the complete original UX-12 criterion after independent source, test-definition, retained real-application capture and source-equivalence review. Full field names remain discoverable in the responsive field rows at the retained 390px witness; current field-level controls compute complete localized field names and target the intended row; built-in, locked, hidden and custom distinctions remain enforced. No application-source correction is needed for this bounded technical scope.
limitations: This artifact is an independent technical review, not an acceptance attestation, issue closure, newly executed test campaign, new browser qualification, release or deployment. The 390px visual evidence is historical actual compiled-app evidence at ec9b3f8; it is carried forward only through the explicit unchanged-layout/source analysis below. No fresh native sweep over every entity/type variant, actual screen-reader speech, assistive-technology certification or exhaustive keyboard campaign is claimed. Actual spoken output is untested and is not an original UX-12 acceptance clause. Current DOM tests mock server actions and router refresh; action-boundary tests mock the database repository; retained real PostgreSQL test definitions cover hidden/locked persistence separately. Successful original-main CI and the later failed same-source tag execution are retained separately. The eventual acceptance revision still needs its own required main checks. Whole-file hashes fence the relevant definitions, not unrelated contents or whole-application certification. No app, database, provider, preview or test process was launched and no peer source was modified.

clause_review.finding: FieldRowItem renders the entire row.name without truncation in a name-first block. The name and active-option summary use break-words and overflow-wrap:anywhere; a separate flex-wrap action row prevents controls from squeezing the title. BuiltinFieldRow similarly wraps labels. The retained actual390px Farsi screenshot visibly contains complete German/Persian custom names, type labels and wrapping actions. These layout definitions and their shared style dependencies are preserved at the reviewed main revision. The generic renderer covers the supported type/entity inputs without per-type truncation branches; exhaustive native permutations are not claimed.

Rename input, Rename, Save, Cancel, Edit options, Archive, Important, Show in add form and Up/Down field-row controls include the full field name. Current EN/DE/FA paired-long-name tests assert exact accessible names, draft names, independent disabled boundaries and callbacks/actions for the intended row. ReorderControls keeps its optional itemName contract, so unnamed callers retain their original labels. Built-in Hidden controls include their localized built-in label.

DataFieldsClient retains separate Built-in and Custom sections and entity-scoped lists. Locked identity fields display Always shown and no Hidden toggle; nonlocked built-ins retain their current hidden state. The page passes built-in locked and hidden values from the catalogue/repository. The server action retains CSRF/metadata.manage validation; hiddenBuiltinsRepo rejects locked and unknown keys before writes and performs idempotent hiding. Existing component/action/real-PostgreSQL test definitions preserve those boundaries.

Header Add, entity selection, name-first rows, contextual actions, deliberate option Save/Cancel, pending guards and saving/saved/error feedback remain represented in the pinned source and tests. The execution record explicitly replaced blur/autosave with deliberate option Save; this review retains that recorded boundary and does not invent an autosave obligation from the title. Later exhaustive native checks remain unexecuted historical verification suggestions; they are not represented as new results.
